name: attendance
definition: 记录某一成员在某一活动中出勤情况的信息条目,以成员与活动的关联为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:成员是参与活动的人这一实体,出勤记录只是描述参与情况的信息条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attendance; provenance: direct source attendance

name: budget
definition: 为某一活动按类别核定并跟踪已用与剩余金额的财务信息条目,以所属活动与预算类别为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与支出(expense)混淆:预算是事先核定的额度,支出是实际发生的费用 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table budget; provenance: direct source budget

name: event
definition: 在特定日期与地点发生、具有名称、类型与状态的业务事件,以发生时间与地点为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与出勤记录(attendance)混淆:活动是发生的事件本身,出勤记录是对参与情况的信息记载 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table event; provenance: direct source event

name: expense
definition: 记录某成员在某日期发生并归属某预算的费用信息条目,以金额、发生日期与审批状态为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与预算(budget)混淆:支出是实际发生的费用记录,预算是事先核定的额度 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table expense; provenance: direct source expense

name: income
definition: 记录某成员在某一日期收到、来自特定来源的款项信息条目,以到账日期与来源为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与费用支出(expense)混淆:收入是资金流入,支出是资金流出 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table income; provenance: direct source income

name: major
definition: 高校中按院系与学院组织的学科专业目录条目,以所属院系与学院为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:专业是学科目录条目,成员是就读或任职于该专业的人 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table major; provenance: direct source major

name: member
definition: 参与组织活动并具有姓名、职位与联系方式等属性的个人,以所属专业为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与专业(major)混淆:成员是个人实体,专业是其所属的学科目录条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table member; provenance: direct source member

name: zip_code
definition: 标识城市、县、州等行政区划的邮政编码目录条目,以所属行政区划为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:邮政编码是地址目录条目,成员是拥有该邮编地址的个人 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table zip_code; provenance: direct source zip_code

name: EventStatus
definition: The current status of an event (e.g., Open, Closed, Planning).

name: ExpenseDescription
definition: A textual description of what an expense was for.

name: ExpenseDate
definition: The date on which an expense was incurred.

name: ExpenseCost
definition: The monetary cost of an individual expense.

name: ExpenseApproved
definition: Whether an expense has been approved.

name: MemberFirstName
definition: The first name of a club member.

name: MemberLastName
definition: The last name of a club member.

name: MemberPhone
definition: The phone number of a club member.

name: MemberPosition
definition: The position or role held by a club member.

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: The t-shirt size of a club member.

name: MajorName
definition: The name of the academic major of a member.

name: MajorDepartment
definition: The department offering the major.

name: EventName
definition: The name of an event.

name: EventType
definition: The type/category of an event.

name: EventDate
definition: The date on which an event occurred.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: The category of a budget item.

name: BudgetSpent
definition: The amount of budget already spent.

name: BudgetRemaining
definition: The remaining budget amount.

name: BudgetAmount
definition: The total allocated budget amount.

name: BudgetEventStatus
definition: The status of the event associated with a budget.

name: AttendanceCount
definition: The number of members who attended an event.

name: ZipCodeCounty
definition: The county associated with a zip code.

name: ZipCodeState
definition: The state associated with a zip code.

name: ZipCodeCity
definition: The city associated with a zip code.

name: IncomeAmount
definition: The amount of income received.

name: IncomeSource
definition: The source of income.

name: FullName
definition: The full name of a member, combining first and last name. Formula: MemberFirstName || ' ' || MemberLastName. Inputs: MemberFirstName = member.first_name; MemberLastName = member.last_name

name: AverageExpenseCost
definition: The average cost of expenses. Formula: AVG(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: TotalExpenseCost
definition: The total cost of expenses. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: SpendToBudgetRatio
definition: The ratio of budget spent to budget amount. Formula: BudgetSpent / BudgetAmount. Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent; BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: BudgetExceeded
definition: Indicates if the budget was exceeded (remaining < 0). Formula: CASE WHEN BudgetRemaining < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: BudgetRemaining = budget.remaining

name: AttendancePerEvent
definition: The number of attendees for an event. Formula: COUNT(AttendanceCount). Inputs: AttendanceCount = attendance.link_to_member

name: EventCost
definition: The total cost associated with an event. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost) GROUP BY EventName. Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost; EventName = event.event_name

name: MemberExpenseTotal
definition: The total expense amount incurred by a member. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost) GROUP BY MemberFirstName, MemberLastName. Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost; MemberFirstName = member.first_name; MemberLastName = member.last_name

name: BudgetVariance
definition: The difference between budget amount and spent. Formula: BudgetAmount - BudgetSpent. Inputs: BudgetAmount = budget.amount; BudgetSpent = budget.spent

name: IncomeTotal
definition: The total income received. Formula: SUM(IncomeAmount). Inputs: IncomeAmount = income.amount

name: EventStatus
definition: Answers questions about the status of events.

name: ExpenseDescription
definition: Answers questions about types of expenses.

name: MemberPosition
definition: Answers questions about member positions.

name: MajorName
definition: Answers questions about academic majors.

name: EventType
definition: Answers questions about event types.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: Answers questions about budget categories.

name: ZipCodeState
definition: Answers questions about states.

name: ZipCodeCounty
definition: Answers questions about counties.
